If this affects your workflow, keep failing closed. There may be no safe workaround; do not widen your allowlist, treat audit mode as protection, or post private job logs here.

Keep this issue open until we can explain the first failure. A passing run on another host isn't proof of a fix. For a Fence fix, verify the affected runner configuration and record the full commit pin from the finalized release. If only the check or its evidence failed, record what happened and how you verified it; no release is needed.
